header.running_head: The Marriages of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.text: from Yathrib and fell into my lap. I however did not want to tell anyone about this until Rasulullaah ﷺ actually arrived. When we were taken captive, the dream gave me hope and Rasulullaah ﷺ eventually set me free and married me. By Allaah! I never spoke to Rasulullaah ﷺ about (freeing) the people of my tribe until the Muslims freed them by themselves. In fact, I only found out about it when one of my cousins informed me about it. Rasulullaah ﷺ's Marriage to Hadhrat Maymoonah bint Haarith Hilaaliyyah (RA)

Hadhrat Ibn Shihaab narrates that it was the year after signing the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah that Rasulullaah ﷺ left to perform Umrah. This occurred seven years after the Hijrah during the month of Dhul Qa'dah, which was the same month in which the Mushrikeen had prevented Rasulullaah ﷺ from entering the Masjidul Haraam (the previous year). When he reached a place called Ya'jij, Rasulullaah ﷺ sent Hadhrat Ja'far bin Abu Taalib (RA) to propose on his behalf for the hand of Hadhrat Maymoonah bint Haarith bin Hazan Aamiriyyah (RA) in marriage. Hadhrat Maymoonah (RA) handed over her affairs to Hadhrat Abbaas bin Abdul Muttalib (RA) who was married to her sister Ummu Fadhl (RA). Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) then handed her over in marriage to Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ stayed over in Sarif for a while until Hadhrat Maymoonah (RA) arrived there and the marriage was consummated. Allaah had decreed that Hadhrat Maymoonah (RA) should pass away at the same place where her marriage to Rasulullaah ﷺ was consummated. [^2]

Another narration states that after marrying Hadhrat Maymoonah bint Haarith (RA), Rasulullaah ﷺ stayed in Makkah for three days. On the third day, Huwaytib bin Abdul Uzza came to Rasulullaah ﷺ with a few men of the Quraysh and said, "Your stay has expired, so leave us." Rasulullaah ﷺ said to them, "What harm will it do to you if you leave me to consummate my marriage in your midst, after which I shall host a meal which you all can attend?" "We have no need for you food," they snapped, "do leave us." Rasulullaah ﷺ therefore left for Madinah with Hadhrat Maymoonah (RA) and consummated his marriage at Sarif. [^3]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Marries his Daughter Hadhrat Faatima (RA) to Hadhrat Ali bin Abi Taalib (RA)

Hadhrat Ali (RA) narrates, "When a marriage proposal for Faatima (RA) was sent to Rasulullaah ﷺ, a slave of mine asked, 'Do you know that a marriage proposal for Faatima (RA) has been sent to Rasulullaah ﷺ?' When I declared that I did not know, she said, 'Well! She has already received a proposal.
Waaqidi, as quoted in Al Bidaayah wan Nihaayah (Vol.4 Pg.159). Haakim (Vol.4 Pg.27) has reported a similar narration.
Haakim (Vol.4 Pg.30), reporting from reliable sources as confirmed by Dhahabi.
